evidence_quotes.agenda: before I go over with our pricing structure and your estimate, do you have any specific concern or stresser about the moving process in general? -- asked, but only after full inventory/logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Not at such but I would love to know your pricing and like how the move would work et cetera. -- an information request, not a concern; N/A full credit applies.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: let's say you were able, they were able to drive quicker they only took four hours for the drive time then we will just be charging you for total time consumed -- explicit beats-it-pay-less coverage on a long-distance move.

top_strength: Excellent handling of an out-of-town (Plano-to-Austin) estimate with transportation and overnight fees clearly broken out and a well-personalized total-hours anchor -- the customer's own recap back ('so totally would be around $3,000') confirms it landed clearly.
coaching_note: The agenda question keeps landing right before the pricing pitch instead of at the top of the call -- move it earlier so any real concerns can shape the whole discovery conversation.
